messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our order history for this part shows 4.12 EUR (po:4500010043-10) against 4.39 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014467-10).
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal and the commitment to a volume of 20,000 pieces per year over 36 months. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we acknowledge the historical prices you cited, our current pricing reflects our present operational focus and costs. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative option, we can offer €4.91 for the 36-month agreement with 60-day payment terms, which provides a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed the forecast data you provided; however, it does not change our calculation, and that does not change our position. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our main offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative option, we can offer €4.91 per unit for a 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms (a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months). 

This represents our firm position based on our current operational focus. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
